summary: The frame of a wall or kiosk view, for a screen on a wall with nobody at a keyboard: no rail and no top bar, only a head (the mark, the title, quiet actions and a large clock), a row of counters, the stage with an aside beside it, and a strip along the bottom. It fills the height it is given on the app's background and the stage takes all the room the rest leaves. In a narrow room everything stacks and the frame scrolls down, never sideways.

anatomy.frame: The whole height it is given, on background in foreground; inside it, an inner column padded 12 holds the pieces 12 apart, 16 and 16 from a room 768 wide, and grows to the frame's height. What does not fit scrolls down inside it; nothing scrolls sideways. A region named by label.
anatomy.head: One row, centered, 12 apart, wrapping onto more lines 4 apart: the mark, the title taking the room left, then the actions and the clock at its end.
anatomy.mark: With mark: the app's mark before the title, at its own size.
anatomy.title: What the wall shows: the page's heading, text.page-title, cut to one line.
anatomy.actions: With actions: quiet buttons before the clock, 4 apart, in muted-foreground.
anatomy.clock: With clock: the time in tabular figures, never wrapping: text.page at 500 below 768 of the room, text.statistic from it.
anatomy.figures: With figures: a row of counters (parts/stat), 12 apart: as many equal columns as fit with none narrower than 144, each row filled to its ends, one column where the room is narrower.
anatomy.stage: All the room the rest leaves, never under 288 tall; what is put on it, such as a map, fills it edge to edge.
anatomy.aside: With aside: from 768 of the room, a column beside the stage at its end, 256, 320 or 384 wide and as tall as the stage, scrolling by itself; below it, under the stage at its own height.
anatomy.foot: With foot: a strip along the bottom, such as an alert ticker (parts/alert-ticker), never shrinking.

mark.does: The app's mark, before the title.

clock.does: The time, drawn large at the head's end.

actions.does: Quiet buttons at the head's end, before the clock.

figures.does: A row of counters under the head, each a stat.

children.does: The stage: what fills the room left, such as a map.

aside.does: Beside the stage in a wide room, under it in a narrow one.

asideWidth.does: The aside's width beside the stage: 256, 320 or 384.

foot.does: A strip along the bottom, such as an alert ticker.

label.does: Names the region for a screen reader.

clock.note: text.page at 500 below 768 of the room.

wide.note: The room's width, not the window's, from which the aside stands beside the stage.

rest.means: The frame drawn in a wide room: the aside beside the stage, the frame as tall as its room.

stacked.means: Everything in one column, the frame scrolling down.

does: Measured on the frame's own room, not the window.
The aside goes under the stage at its own height, and the stage keeps at least 288 of height.
The frame's padding and gaps are 12 rather than 16, and the clock is text.page at 500.
The counters wrap to as many columns as fit at 144 each: two on a phone.
The frame scrolls down and never sideways.

keyboard.does: Moves through the actions, then whatever the stage, the aside and the foot hold.

appText.title: The wall's title.
appText.clock: The time, as the app writes it.
appText.label: The region's name.

sokkel-ui: The frame is a container (@container) and changes at @3xl, 48rem of its own width.
The stage's content is laid over the stage's box (absolute, inset 0) as a column whose children each take the room, so a map needs no height of its own.
The frame is h-full: its parent gives it a height, such as h-svh for a whole screen.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such pattern.
